newsitem.title: UK: British takeover claims to be curbed - paper.
newsitem.headline: British takeover claims to be curbed - paper.

text.p: Companies mounting takeover bids on the London Stock Exchange can no longer make unsubstantiated claims about financial benefits under rule changes made by the Takeover Panel, the Financial Times said on Friday.
The newspaper said any claim about the impact on profitability of either the target company or the bidder must be vouched for by financial advisers and accountants.
Any company making a claim would also have to give a full explanation of the assumptions on which it was based, the Financial Times said.
